text: How much harmine and harmaline end up in a home-made oil can vary, so don't use Syrian rue in any form alongside antidepressants, MDMA, other MAOIs, or anything else on the stop list under Suspected Serotonin Syndrome. And if someone's on a prescribed antipsychotic, don't swap it for this oil without checking with whoever prescribed it.
section: Syrian Rue Oil (under Mental Stabilizers That Don't Abort the Trip)
reader: someone who has just read his Syrian rue oil paragraphs and is thinking of using the oil, maybe while on medication, or for a friend in psychosis

sentences.s: How much harmine and harmaline end up in a home-made oil can vary, so don't use Syrian rue in any form alongside antidepressants, MDMA, other MAOIs, or anything else on the stop list under Suspected Serotonin Syndrome.
sentences.payoff: they know not to combine any form of Syrian rue with their antidepressant, MDMA, another MAOI or anything on the serotonin stop list, and why: nobody can tell how much harmine and harmaline their own oil carries
sentences.follows: it answers the question his paragraphs leave open for someone on medication: he says the oil carries little harmine or harmaline, and that whole seeds vaped may carry more

sentences.s: And if someone's on a prescribed antipsychotic, don't swap it for this oil without checking with whoever prescribed it.
sentences.payoff: someone caring for a friend in psychosis, after reading of his friend who used the oil instead of Geodon, knows not to drop a prescribed antipsychotic for it without the prescriber
sentences.follows: the second case the paragraphs above raise: his friend's psychosis, and the antipsychotic he was prescribed

placement: the last paragraph of his new Syrian Rue Oil entry, right after his vaping paragraph (which ends on vaporizing the harmine and harmaline), before the divider that ends Mental Stabilizers That Don't Abort the Trip; 'this oil' points to the oil his entry describes
